foot: x, y = bottom-centre pixel of the sticker frame; draw at left = x - w//2, top = y - h + 1
draw_order: sort every sticker by foot y (then x), back to front, over the base picture

stages.stage1: just arrived: bare timber barraca frame, broken calcadao, 3 of 8 lamps work
stages.stage2: getting going: the striped barraca opens, volleyball court, Posto 9, parasols, bike rack, all but one lamp
stages.stage3: fully developed: two parasol clusters with a clear path between, surf rack, mate cart, bunting, the Reveillon flower boat, kites (day), every lamp lit

looks.rain: rain palette (day hues, a little darker, cool sky light), lamps lit, wet-sand sheen and reflections, puddles, rain rings; parasols furled, chairs folded, loungers stood on end, towels packed; two walkers; animate overlays/rain-beach-{0,1,2}.png on top (about 120 ms a frame)
looks.night: night palette + glow; parasols furled; lamps, reflections, barraca string lights, cyan surf and stars are baked in

barraca.note: walk in to go under the tent (barraca/), once the Barraca is open (day 3)
